title: Close 2026-07-01 D&D SRD audit findings
description:
Parent epic for every finding from the 2026-07-01 D&D SRD audit synthesis. Do not treat closed older beads as satisfying these findings; the latest audit still found them or found residual issues after those beads closed.

Inputs synthesized:
- ChatGPT manual review of the audit bundle.
- Codex GPT-5.5 max-effort parallel audit.
- Claude Fable-5 max-effort independent full-coverage audit.

Bundle/repo context:
- Audit bundle commit: beb9a21.
- Pack size: 1,812 records.
- SRD source pages reviewed: 403.
- All bundle commands and existing gates were green, but the audits still found defects and gate blind spots.

Fable verification method worth preserving in downstream beads:
- Did not reuse repo audit code.
- Rebuilt column-aware source reading order from items.json coordinates because .txt interleaves columns.
- Normalized PDF hyphen/ligature/one-half/minus artifacts.
- Required every 6-token shingle on every source page to be reproducible from pack prose or reconstructed renderings of structured fields.
- Reconstructed spell headers, full creature statlines including derived ability modifiers and CR-to-XP, equipment/armor/weapon table rows, class hit-point/proficiency boilerplate from hitDie, and class spell lists from spell.classes[].
- Verified every prose string and every structured field of all 1,812 records against cited source windows.
- Ran a digit-bearing token pass for DCs, dice, ranges, durations, averages, attack bonuses, CR/XP, equipment values, armorClass structures, and concentration/ritual flags.
- Reported zero numeric corruptions, exact class spell-list parity, and strong source fidelity overall.
- Durable copy of the harness and its reports: ~/src/dnd5e-srd-audit-harness-070126/

Policy for this epic:
- Every finding below must be closed by code/data fix, durable gate, or explicit documented non-issue decision.
- Broad findings must be split into children rather than silently deferred.
- Ambiguous findings require research/verification beads.
- A subsequent audit should not find any noted issue still present unless an accepted non-issue is recorded.
- This epic blocks eshyra-o9bd.14 (regenerate + re-freeze): the pack must not be re-frozen while findings here are open or undecided.
